symptom: `alter page … set (OnChange: call microflow …) on txtAmount` was refused by check and exec as "not a pluggable widget and has no named action slots", though create page writes and describe prints the text box's OnChange; the refusal pointed at `set (Action: …)`, which addresses a click action a text box does not have. OnEnter / OnLeave / OnEnterKeyPress were in the same state.
cause: Every action-valued SET key other than the click keyword went to SetWidgetNamedAction, which only knew pluggable widgets' Object.Properties slots and refused any widget without an Object.
fix: A built-in widget's event action is written into its stored key (OnChangeAction, OnEnterAction, OnLeaveAction, OnEnterKeyPressAction), addressed by the MDL name create page reads or the stored name, and only where the stored widget holds that key; otherwise refused naming the event actions it has.
insight: The dispatch was decided by key shape (click keyword vs anything else) when the widget kind is what decides where an action lives. The write-only-where-the-key-exists rule from SetWidgetAction carries over: Studio Pro throws on an unknown property while mxbuild builds clean.
test: mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator_event_action_test.go TestSetWidgetNamedAction_BuiltInInputEvents_2602 (each event, both spellings, other events untouched) and _BuiltInWithoutTheEvent_2602 (text area, no OnEnterKeyPress) failed with the issue's message before the fix. Live (issue repro on testdata/expr-checker): check passes, exec alters, second exec unchanged, describe shows OCH_Updated and the new OnLeave; mx check 11.17.0's only error is CE0535 from the repro's bare `column`, the same on main without the alter.
